name: stfu-waveform
label: STFU waveform
description: Waveform backgrounds, title cards and explainers for the STFU video.
author: Joe Lloyd

templates.name: StfuBackground
templates.label: STFU background
templates.description: Ink, grid and slow waveform. Put one clip under the whole video.

templates.name: StfuStage
templates.label: STFU stage
templates.description: The part, title and one graphic a shot is about. All text on it comes from its fields.

fields.label: Chapter
fields.description: The part this shot belongs to, top right, e.g. 03 / How it works. Empty hides it.

fields.label: Items
fields.description: One entry per line. pipeline: a box per line. compare: 'Heading: text' per panel. demo: pasted message, then placeholder. speed: big figure, then 'Name: share' rows (share 1 = full bar). ownership/retention: a card per line. fallback: a box per line. title/outro/end: chips, or empty for the pill. Other scenes: a quote block. Empty shows nothing.
Optional image URL or embedded data URL for a settings still.

templates.name: StfuLabels
templates.label: STFU labels
templates.description: Optional small text over a shot. Every label is a field; leave it empty to hide it.

fields.label: Brand
fields.description: Top left, after a pink dot.

fields.label: Kicker
fields.description: Small caps line above the title.
